title: Janitorial Walkthrough Work Order Form
subtitle: Janitorial Walkthrough: connects authorized scope to results.
description: Janitorial Walkthrough Work Order Form covers cleaning zone, surface, fixture, supply point, waste stream, and service task. The facility cleaning coordinator records Janitorial Walkthrough authorized tasks, materials, results, and changes. Janitorial Walkthrough Work Order Form keeps Janitorial Walkthrough exceptions visible until the facility cleaning coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Janitorial Walkthrough Work Order Form at occupied rooms, restrooms, common areas, service closets, and restricted zones. Document cleaning zone, surface, fixture, supply point, waste stream, and service task identity before Janitorial Walkthrough begins. Compare cleaning zone, surface, fixture, supply point, waste stream, and service task findings with stated Janitorial Walkthrough criteria; route unresolved Janitorial Walkthrough issues to janitorial quality supervisor.

sections.title: Customer, provider, and approved-work evidence
sections.guidance: For Janitorial Walkthrough, identify responsible parties, occupied rooms, restrooms, common areas, service closets, and restricted zones, and the linked cleaning zone, surface, fixture, supply point, waste stream, and service task source.

fields.label: Scope standard, service level, and prior deficiency reference

sections.title: Work-order tasks, resources, and results
sections.guidance: Capture Janitorial Walkthrough facts for cleaning zone, surface, fixture, supply point, waste stream, and service task; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Janitorial Walkthrough authorized-work checks
items: Soil, residue, touchpoint, floor, and fixture condition
Waste, recycling, sharps, or special-stream handling
Chemical label, dilution, container, and storage condition
Room release, odor, damage, and recurring deficiency

sections.title: Work evidence and customer acknowledgment
sections.guidance: Resolve open Janitorial Walkthrough conditions; have facility cleaning coordinator assign the next Janitorial Walkthrough owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Scope changes, holds, and retained evidence
items: Damaged surface or fixture outside cleaning scope
Restricted room or privacy boundary not cleared
Wet-floor or access control cannot be maintained
blocks.guidance: Pause Janitorial Walkthrough when an unknown exposure, restricted-area concern, public slip risk, or unresolved damage remains. Retain the available Janitorial Walkthrough proof and route unresolved cleaning zone, surface, fixture, supply point, waste stream, and service task scope to facility cleaning coordinator.
